structure.unit: Licensure of Minors, Student Drivers, School Bus Drivers, and Motorcyclists

law.catch_line: Knowledge test; waiting period prior to reexamination
law.text: Any person under the age of eighteen who applies for a learner's permit under § 46.2-335 and fails the motor vehicle knowledge test administered pursuant to that section shall not be eligible for retesting for at least fifteen days.
